tasks.label: cleanup-unwanted-files
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $paths=@('tests audio/outputs_keywords_final','tests audio/outputs_rerun5','tests audio/outputs_rerun6','tests audio/outputs_rerun7','.pytest_cache','src/__pycache__','tests/__pycache__','data/call_analytics.db'); foreach($p in $paths){ if(Test-Path $p){ Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $p } }; Write-Output 'cleanup-complete'

tasks.label: cleanup-unwanted-files-python
final-db-cleanup
args: if exist "data\call_analytics.db" (del /f /q "data\call_analytics.db" && echo db-removed) else (echo db-not-found)

tasks.label: find-python-lockers
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'python*' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: stop-python-and-delete-db
args: taskkill /F /IM python.exe >nul 2>nul & taskkill /F /IM pythonw.exe >nul 2>nul & if exist "data\call_analytics.db" del /f /q "data\call_analytics.db" & if exist "data\call_analytics.db" (echo db-still-present) else (echo db-removed)

tasks.label: git-config-user-hcl
args: git config user.name "SajivJess" && git config user.email "sajivjess@users.noreply.github.com" && echo git-user-configured

tasks.label: git-add-commit-hcl
args: git add . && git commit -m "Prepare deployment, docs, and endpoint validation guidance"
